description: Myanmar - Solar irradiation and PV power potential maps is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Myanmar. Map with solar irradiation and PV power potential in Myanmar. The GIS data (AAIGRID and GEOTIFF) stems from the Global Solar Atlas ( info). The link also provides a poster size (. tif) and midsize map (. png). The Global Solar Atlas is continuously updated. Coverage: Myanmar. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Myanmar. Its tags are City profiles, Energy. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp. The portal shows 2019-11-01 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
